records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent TWO-FIGURE WAKING SPRITE SHEET for Rift of Reason opening cutscene, Stage13.78. Image1 approved STYLE BOARD is authoritative for medium dark-brown outlines, softly textured cel shading and jewel accents in a cute-dark storybook world. Image2 is the EXACT AVATAR IDENTITY and complete anatomy/costume reference: the first full figure in top row is BOY, the first full figure in lower row is GIRL; ignore its cropped busts. Image3 shows the accepted SLEEPING partners: retain exact identities, cream pillow and violet/moss patchwork cloth materials, but draw a NEW FULL-BODY WAKING pose, not an edit that only opens eyes. Wide 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Exactly two separate COMPLETE groups side by side, same scale, boy entirely LEFT and girl entirely RIGHT, at least 150px empty transparent vertical gap between nearest pixels and at least 65px genuine transparent outer margins on all four sides. EACH child has just sat upright on the bed: head, neck, shoulders, whole torso, both forelimbs/wings, hips, bent knees and BOTH feet/talons/boots clearly visible. A cream pillow leans behind the back; a SMALL crumpled quilt strip is pushed to one side beside the hip, touching the group, NOT covering the chest, lap, knees or feet. Seen from FOOT OF BED, low gentle front three-quarter view, knees bent and feet resting forward; do not paint any bed or room. Hands/wingtips brace beside the hips, shoulders raised, eyes very wide and mouth/beak slightly open with a frightened held breath; looking UP towards a window just beyond camera, startled and vulnerable rather than screaming, smiling or fighting. All anatomy, ears/antennae, tail/wings, pillow, cloth and feet remain INSIDE the canvas and inside that character's half. Each character+pillow+small cloth makes ONE connected silhouette for clean cutting. Match the reference rendering: warm dim lantern rim with a restrained cool cyan edge, deep violet shadows, readable expression, no gore or realistic human face. No bust/waist crop, no disconnected head, no lower-body crop, no giant blanket hiding the body. No extra poses, letters, numbers, labels, frame, logo, floor shadow blob, painted checkerboard, glow cloud or background scene. TRUE transparent background. Identity details: LEFT boy: orange fox kit with cream muzzle/chest, forest-green neckerchief, cream shirt, brown trousers, brown paws and his bushy cream-tipped tail. RIGHT girl: red-orange fox kit with cream muzzle/chest, mustard duffle coat with toggle buttons, dark legs/paws and a red ribbon tied near the bushy cream-tipped tail. No hats.
records.visualReview: First take accepted: complete startled seated body, both feet visible, matching species/costume and pillow/quilt materials; coherent cute-dark rendering and separated groups. No head or torso crop. Actual alpha, split and in-game framing are checked separately.

records.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied two-frog transparent waking-pose sprite sheet. Preserve the two existing frog characters' identity, expressions, clothing, boots, lily hat, seated poses, pillows, quilt pattern, ink outlines and warm storybook rendering. Fix ONLY the framing and the missing quilt edges: zoom both complete assemblies out slightly and draw the complete rounded outer quilt ends that currently touch/cross the left and right canvas edges. There must be a clearly visible transparent margin of at least 6 percent of canvas width around every outermost pixel of BOTH assemblies, including quilts, hats, pillows and boot soles. Keep a generous fully transparent vertical gap between the boy on the left and girl on the right so each is a separate connected island. Keep both complete full-body figures seated with feet visible. True transparent background; no opaque backdrop, no glow haze, no ground shadow, no text, no new objects, no cropping anywhere. Keep the two characters the same apparent size as each other.
